ADDED · Receive source-controller facts before furnace programs run.
ADDED · More than one selected/stamped part is ambiguous; never pick the last scanned position.
ADDED · The selected part requires one unambiguous 50 MN or 300 MN destination.
ADDED · Reject multiple accepted wash returns across the two-furnace scan.
ADDED · Release the sole accepted return only after checking both furnace passes.
ADDED · Begin the next accepted-return scan.
ADDED · Commit the candidate only after both furnace Pre dispatches have been scanned.
ADDED · Freeze the selected part/load identity before the legacy item can be moved or cleared.

ADDED · Begin a fresh two-furnace selection pass; capture the existing destination selections.
ADDED · Use the selected press, not an OR of both presses.

ADDED · A second CDL start while a part is still handled is an overrun.
ADDED · Selected CDL adapter removal/transfer-start observation, with its source timestamp.
ADDED · Source furnace must match the frozen identity; a start may arrive before the stamp selection pass.
ADDED · Do not replace an unconsumed selected-press edge.
ADDED · Latch only the selected 50 MN press Cycle Start; unrelated press events cannot close this transfer.
ADDED · Do not replace an unconsumed selected-press edge.

ADDED · Retain the arrival timestamp while allowing a one-second operator-decision window.
ADDED · Delay cycle publication for one second so a near-simultaneous HMI decision can be captured first; this does not alter the measured arrival time.
ADDED · Qualifying time maps to the retained legacy SoakTimer.ACC; clocks retain their explicit commissioning setting.
